title: Run registry
description: The enumeration mechanism and the generator's input. Its rows DEFINE what is a run (hand-verified — no path-depth rule can enumerate runs, since the same directory depth means 'condition' in one subtree and 'run' in another). It maps the stable run_id to the current directory_path; the path column is the single place a directory reorganisation edits. Non-runs (outputs/results/, figures/, qgis-*/, stub manifests) are simply omitted.

run_id.description: Stable flat slug (primary key); never changes once assigned.

directory_path.description: Current location under outputs/. The one field a directory reorganisation edits.

status.description: 'planned' declares intent BEFORE execution: the run is held in the registry but excluded from the generated manifests, which describe only what exists on disk. Its directory_path is the intended location and need not exist yet. Promote to 'active' once the run has executed.

planned_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the run was declared planned. Drives the staleness warning; only meaningful while status is 'planned'. REQUIRED when status is 'planned' — without it the staleness alarm can never fire, which would silently exempt exactly the carelessly-authored entries it exists to catch.

notes.description: Free text, e.g. why a sibling directory is omitted, or a rename-history pointer.
